source_review: The precise BornRedundancy theorem is for Int 2x2 matrices, Int vectors and equality of exact coordinate squares, including zero and scale. All-ones sends (1,1) to (2,2) and (1,-1) to zero: nonzero outputs share one projective ray, while retaining zero distinguishes the cancellation. Native probes include diagonal and anti-diagonal sparse controls.
